detail: the panel is the one this task was frozen against
PANEL-RTDNA-81 is exactly the rows with a measured RTDNA_sequence

expectation: all 81 anchors carry an ncRNA_sequence to map onto
detail: an anchor without its own ncRNA cannot be mapped and would be INPUT_MISSING

expectation: a fragment planted at 41..130 is found EXACT_UNIQUE, FORWARD, at 41..130
detail: coordinates are 1-based inclusive on the ncRNA

expectation: its reverse complement is found REVCOMP at the same 41..130
detail: both orientations are always tested and which one matched is landed

expectation: a fragment planted TWICE reports n_placements=2 and BOTH coordinate sets
detail: ⛔ there is NO tie-break; the number of equally valid placements IS a result

expectation: an unrelated random sequence of the same length is UNMAPPED, not forced
detail: the mapper does not invent a coordinate for something that is not there

expectation: a fragment with 3 planted substitutions is NEAR_EXACT with the mismatches counted
detail: exact and near-exact are reported SEPARATELY, never merged into 'mapped'

expectation: a chimera of 20 nt real + 90 nt random falls below the declared floor and is UNMAPPED
detail: floor declared in advance: coverage>=0.9 AND identity>=0.9

expectation: all 81 anchors appear in the output with an explicit state
detail: ⛔ an anchor is never dropped; UNMAPPED and AMBIGUOUS are states, not omissions
